title: Living in the colony: mestizaje and what it left
goal: Read how colonial society changed and what it left behind, and use verbs of change to say how people, groups and cities became different.

items: Use *convertirse en*, *hacerse*, *quedarse* and *pasar de ser … a ser …* to say how people and groups changed.
Say what mestizaje became in colonial life.
Say why many criollos were unhappy, according to many historians.
Say what Spanish became in much of America.
Use the key words of change: mestizaje, craftsman, merchant, post and inequality.
